<thought>To find the appropriate Diels‑Alder retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for templates applicable to the target molecule without specifying bond formats (since the required format caused an error). This will return candidate templates, from which I can identify the Diels‑Alder one and then apply it to get the precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>
